description: This Java class 'Cohort' models a collection of patient memberships within the OpenMRS medical record system, offering methods to manage, query, and perform set operations on patient cohorts.

classes.name: Cohort
classes.description: Represents a group of patients, with functionalities to add, remove, and query patient memberships, including set operations like union, intersection, and subtraction.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a patient with the given patientId is a member of the cohort.

methods.name: addMember
methods.description: Adds a patient ID as a new member to the cohort.

methods.name: addMembership
methods.description: Adds a CohortMembership object to the cohort's memberships.

methods.name: removeMembership
methods.description: Removes a specific CohortMembership from the cohort.

methods.name: getMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves all memberships, optionally including voided ones.

methods.name: getActiveMemberships
methods.description: Returns active memberships as of a specific date or current date.

methods.name: getActiveMembership
methods.description: Fetches the active membership for a specific patient.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of non-voided members in the cohort.

methods.name: hasActiveMembership
methods.description: Checks if a patient has an active membership in the cohort.

methods.name: activeMembershipSize
methods.description: Returns the count of active memberships.

methods.name: hasNoActiveMemberships
methods.description: Returns true if there are no active memberships in the cohort.

methods.name: union
methods.description: Creates a new cohort that is the union of two cohorts.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Returns a cohort that is the intersection of two cohorts.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Removes the memberships of one cohort from another.
